metadata.description: OutSystems MCP plugin for Claude Code and Claude Desktop

plugins.name: outsystems
plugins.description: Edit, publish, deploy, and search OutSystems apps, and manage external libraries, from your AI assistant. Connects to your own OutSystems tenant's MCP server over OAuth.

plugins.name: legacy-modernization
plugins.description: [Limited availability] Modernize legacy applications onto OutSystems on a live ODC tenant: extract the requirements from legacy sources (/extract-requirements), design the replacement app (/generate-design-options), build and verify it (/workflow-legacy-app), the migration close-out documents, the test evidence pack, a toolkit overview (/how-it-works), and the planner, designer, developer, reviewer, tester and reporter roles. Uses the outsystems plugin's MCP server and its Mentor build skills.
